assumptions: PC 原版；按每个目标单独命中，无维修、衰减变化或溅射共享。
粘附爆炸物按成功贴附并爆炸；火箭按直接命中；不计哑火等待。
仅比较所列单一爆炸物方案的新增硫磺，不代表混搭或所有资源的全局最优。
发射器、学习蓝图、建造工作台的成本不包含在消耗品成本中。

cache_benchmark.query: C4需要几级工作台，解释蓝图条件
cache_benchmark.limitations: Single-process paired queries on a tiny local corpus, excludes installation and HTTP. Cache hits still validate package, revocations and index; no production speedup guarantee.

limitations: Authored deterministic retrieval and failure fixtures, not independent Rust truth or live model accuracy

16 development queries and 8 reserved queries, frozen before first evaluation. Reserved mechanism families are mixing, fuel, unknown_hp, feedback, batch and inventory. The rule corpus is shared; this is not a source-independent or human-blind holdout.

B0/B1 reuse the existing relevant() coarse topic predicate on the same local retrieval view, same 5-document/6000-character budget. They are controlled adapters, not a replay of live web/model behavior at the baseline commit.
Eligibility and status checks are software-contract fixtures; they do not establish semantic correctness of every curated claim or game build applicability.
Case latency measures one query after fault preparation; cache corruption cases intentionally prewarm. It excludes installation and model/network latency; no general production speedup is claimed.
